summary: The parent marks nodes discovered when pushed, which can produce incorrect DFS preorder, and unconditionally emits popped nodes, allowing move_to on an already-discovered start to emit it again. The fix marks nodes discovered at pop time, skips previously discovered nodes, and removes pre-visiting from move_to. A verbatim implementation reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision: the fix adds no tests, existing iterative DFS tests check reachability or counts rather than preorder, and the CSR restart test resets discovery first. Leave blocked pending an eligible upstream regression test; no tests were executed.
